title: Prime Minister extends greetings to ITBP personnel on their Raising Day
body_text:
Prime Minister Shri Narendra Modi today extended his greetings to all personnel of the Indo-Tibetan Border Police (ITBP) on their Raising Day. The Prime Minister praised the ITBP Himveers for distinguishing themselves through their exceptional valour and noted that they have always risen to every challenge with remarkable determination. He added that their selfless service and sacrifices are a source of immense inspiration to the nation. The Prime Minister shared on X: "On their Raising Day, greetings to all personnel of the ITBP. The ITBP Himveers have distinguished themselves through their exceptional valour. They have always risen to every challenge with remarkable determination. Their selfless service and sacrifices are a source of immense inspiration to the nation. @ITBP_official" On their Raising Day, greetings to all personnel of the ITBP.

The ITBP Himveers have distinguished themselves through their exceptional valour. 

They have always risen to every challenge with remarkable determination. 

Their selfless service and sacrifices are a source of immense inspiration to the nation.
